title: With season approaching, "nothing is imminent" as to new NFL broadcast deals

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With season approaching, "nothing is imminent" as to new NFL broadcast deals
sources.description: Not long ago, it seemed inevitable that the NFL would renegotiate most of its current broadcast deals before the start of the 2026 season, with the idea that the existing partners would pay more for NFL games — starting with the 2026 season.
